verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents analytics dashboards (performance monitoring, benchmarking, recovery analytics) and automated Smart Retries. None of the evidence describes AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The MCP server lets external agents call the API, which is an adjacent building block rather than in-product AI insights, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
